**Enum** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public enum DuplexMode
```

Enumerates the ways pages can be printed on one or both sides of the paper.

## Values

- **`PrinterDefault`** (`0`): Use the printer's default setting.
- **`OneSided`** (`1`): Print on one side of the paper only.
- **`LongEdge`** (`2`): Print on both sides, turning the page on its long edge (like a book in portrait).
- **`ShortEdge`** (`3`): Print on both sides, turning the page on its short edge (like a notepad in portrait).
